description: Completed trades for a wallet: each row is a full position from open to close with entry, exit, size, gross and net PnL, fees, funding and how long it was held. Best tool for judging trading skill ("what is this wallet's win rate and best coin?"). Default window: last 30 days. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 100, max 500).

name: hydromancer_wallet_closed_trades
title: Wallet closed trades (open-to-close round trips)
